purpose: Provide C an independently inspectable executable verification path bound to exact Step-003 bytes, without trusting Builder/Quantum self-report and without requiring a connector-to-local-filesystem transfer path.

binding_requirements.rule: CI evidence is inadmissible if the checked-out commit/tree or any required artifact blob differs from C fresh-read values at verification time. Prompt values are hints only; C must fresh-read latest authority and recompute bindings.

trusted_ci_contract.trigger: manual workflow_dispatch or branch-scoped verification run only; no production deployment
trusted_ci_contract.checkout: exact commit/tree bound to the C-fresh-read branch snapshot
test_scope: memory full-spectrum adapter tests including adversarial cases
required_preflight: print and persist checked-out commit SHA and tree SHA
recompute Git blob SHA for each required source/test/contract artifact
fail closed before tests on any mismatch
required_postflight: capture unittest exit code and exact test count
capture before/after fingerprints for mission authority inputs used by the run
assert no live Identity/Personality/Governance write path was exercised
assert no main/default write, deploy, spend, secret persistence, package install, model download or training occurred
trusted_ci_contract.artifact_output: single compact machine-readable verification manifest plus raw CI logs retained by the CI platform; do not create per-test durable repo files
trusted_ci_contract.verdict_boundary: CI success is evidence only. Only formal LCR-C may issue PASS/FAIL/DEFER/HUMAN_GATE after independently checking the run binding and outputs.

negative_cases: CI run on same branch name but different tree SHA => REJECT
test success with artifact blob mismatch => REJECT
Builder-authored summary without CI run identity/logs => REJECT
package installation or downloaded dependencies during verification => REJECT_OR_DEFER
formal_adoption_path: A may route this candidate as a bounded verifier-enablement repair; B may implement the workflow/spec on the non-main mission branch if formally assigned; C independently validates run binding and issues the only formal verdict.
